params.mechanism: hvx-compute: N vectorised 64-fp16-lanes-at-a-time (outer-product accumulation over K), qf32 accumulate, single narrow to fp16 at the end of each row's K loop
params.hmx_attempted: yes -- abandoned after the standalone gate runtime hung when the kernel enabled the HMX/SSR.XE extension context from inside kernel.c; see the kernel-matmul-report.md for what was tried
params.fallback: plain scalar float32-accumulate loop for N wider than this kernel's fixed 8-block (512-column) accumulator; a per-column scalar tail handles any N not a multiple of 64
